960	You have to understand what the smell was like in the morning, how the whole house had to be disinfected in the morning, and how everyone was getting ready in the morning,	É preciso entender como era o cheiro de manhã, como a casa inteira tinha de ser higienizada de manhã, e como cada um se preparava de manhã,
961	each one for his own learning, and Mom conducting it all, while she herself	cada um para o seu estudo, e a mamãe regendo tudo, sendo ela mesma
962	was also a kindergarten teacher, and she also had to be at work.	também professora de jardim de infância, e ainda tinha de estar no trabalho.
963	So it happened one day that one of the children arrived at kindergarten with shoes that were two	Então um dia, um dos filhos chegou ao jardim com sapatos que eram dois
964	mismatched ones.	pés de pares diferentes.
965	When Dad noticed, while he was at home, that here were two mismatched shoes, he understood that the child had gone with two	Quando o papai percebeu, estando em casa, que ali havia dois sapatos desemparelhados, entendeu que o filho tinha ido com dois
966	mismatched shoes.	sapatos desemparelhados.
967	He went to the trouble, made the effort, and replaced the shoes.	Ele se deu ao trabalho, se esforçou e trocou os sapatos.
968	So that he wouldn't have two mismatched ones, so that he'd have a pair.	Para que ele não ficasse com dois pés diferentes, para que tivesse um par.
969	He took the trouble and the effort; his eye was watching, his eye was in the Gemara learning, in holy	Ele se deu ao trabalho e ao esforço; seu olho vigiava, seu olho estava na Guemará, no estudo, nos yichudim	
970	yichudim, but also on the shoes and the order of the children.	sagrados, mas também nos sapatos e na ordem dos filhos.
971	In our house all the shoes stood like soldiers; there's no such thing as scattered shoes,	Em nossa casa todos os sapatos ficavam como soldados; não existia sapato espalhado,
972	no such things, clothes thrown about; there was never anything like that in our lives.	nada disso, roupas jogadas; nunca houve algo assim em nossa vida.
973	No garment was ever thrown down; everything was organized, in order, even the laundry, everything arranged.	Nenhuma roupa ficava jogada; tudo era organizado, em ordem, até a roupa lavada, tudo arrumado.
974	Dad and Mom were orderly, so when Dad noticed a scattered shoe, not	Papai e mamãe eram organizados, então quando o papai notou um sapato espalhado, fora	
975	in order, two mismatched ones, he went and changed his shoes for him.	de ordem, dois desemparelhados, foi e trocou os sapatos dele.
976	Once, one of the girls forgot to take food from home for recess.	Uma vez, uma das meninas esqueceu de levar comida de casa para o recreio.
977	Suddenly Dad arrived at the school with full bags, fruit and food.	De repente o papai chegou à escola com sacolas cheias, frutas e comida.
978	"You forgot to take a meal, you forgot to take fruit."	"Você esqueceu de levar a refeição, esqueceu de levar frutas."
979	When the children were studying in yeshivot, yeshivot even outside the city,	Quando os filhos estudavam em yeshivot, yeshivot até fora da cidade,
980	Dad would accompany them to the buses, sometimes get on the bus with them, sit with them inside	o papai os acompanhava até os ônibus, às vezes entrava no ônibus com eles, sentava com eles lá dentro
981	until the driver started the engine and actually drove off, and then Dad would get off, waving his hands,	até o motorista ligar o motor e de fato partir, aí o papai descia, acenando com as mãos,
982	outside, waiting until the children passed by and disappeared from his sight, and only then would he return	do lado de fora, esperando até os filhos passarem e sumirem de sua vista, e só então voltava
983	home.	para casa.
984	Accompanying to the yeshiva, accompanying to the bus.	Acompanhar até a yeshivá, acompanhar até o ônibus.
985	When I was a young man and studied at a yeshiva in Beit Vegan in Jerusalem,	Quando eu era jovem e estudava numa yeshivá em Beit Vegan, em Jerusalém,
986	I studied then at Yeshivat Or Baruch of Rabbi Toledano, of blessed memory, Rabbi	estudei então na Yeshivat Or Baruch do Rav Toledano, de memória abençoada, o Rav
987	Michael, Rabbi Gabriel, Rabbi Omer, of blessed memory.	Michael, o Rav Gabriel, o Rav Omer, de memória abençoada.
988	When I studied there at the yeshiva, Dad and Mom came and took me on the first day,	Quando estudei lá na yeshivá, o papai e a mamãe vieram me levar no primeiro dia,
989	sat with me, and didn't budge until they saw that the bed was made there in the dormitory and that everything	sentaram comigo e não saíram até verem que a cama estava arrumada lá no dormitório e que tudo
990	and that I was settled in, and they would come to visit me and bring me trays of things.	e que eu estava acomodado, e vinham me visitar e me traziam bandejas de comidas.
991	How much responsibility, how much warmth, how much love, how much	Quanta responsabilidade, quanto calor, quanto amor, quanto
992	caring. My brother Rabbi Shmuel tells	cuidado. Meu irmão, o Rav Shmuel, conta
993	that when he would go to yeshiva and come back at night, to sleep at night, our father would come	que quando ele ia para a yeshivá e voltava à noite, para dormir, nosso pai vinha
994	in the night hours, go over to Rabbi Shmuel's bed, stroke his face,	pelas horas da noite, ia até a cama do Rav Shmuel, acariciava seu rosto
995	and put five new shekels there for him and say to him, "This is pocket money, buy yourself something with it."	e colocava ali cinco novos shekalim e dizia: "Isto é mesada, compre algo com isso."
996	My brother Rabbi Shmuel received a caress, received five shekels. I	Meu irmão, o Rav Shmuel, recebeu um carinho, recebeu cinco shekalim. Eu	
997	remember that before there were shekels, I received from my father six lirot as	lembro que, antes de haver shekalim, recebi do meu pai seis liras de
998	pocket money, lirot, which was lirot in the days of school,	mesada, liras, que eram liras nos tempos da escola,
999	weekly pocket money.	mesada semanal.
